annotations.title: Save a snapshot of my application funnel

description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Saves the current state of the signed-in user's application funnel so they can compare response and interview rates over time (the Apply Tracker flow chart shows the saved ones). Saving again when nothing changed since the latest snapshot adds nothing. At most 50 per user.

label.description: A short name for this snapshot, e.g. "Cuối tháng 10". Optional.

name: save_insights_snapshot
title: Save a snapshot of my application funnel
